description: Calculate a CVSS Base-only score for 2.0, 3.0, 3.1 or 4.0. Supply every metric; never guess. v2: AV Access Vector, AC Access Complexity, Au Authentication, C/I/A Confidentiality/Integrity/Availability. v3: AV Attack Vector, AC Attack Complexity, PR Privileges Required, UI User Interaction, S Scope, C/I/A impact. v4: AT Attack Requirements, VC/VI/VA Vulnerable System impact, SC/SI/SA Subsequent System impact. Rejects non-Base metrics.

vector.description: Complete case-sensitive Base-only vector. v2: AV L/A/N, AC H/M/L, Au M/S/N, C/I/A N/P/C. v3: AV N/A/L/P, AC L/H, PR N/L/H, UI N/R, S U/C, C/I/A H/L/N. v4: AV N/A/L/P, AC L/H, AT N/P, PR N/L/H, UI N/P/A, VC/VI/VA/SC/SI/SA H/L/N.

name: calculate_cvss
